ED Format Board

Every container on the table for "The Part Nobody Fixed," with a real example where one exists. Tap a link to watch the competitor ad; our own files are listed by path. Built 10/19 from the format rolodex, Motion 2026 benchmarks, the X pull and TrendTrack.

Picks for this story, in order

PROVEN on DirectMax

1. Comment reply longform (3-4 min)

A comment sits on screen ('does the blue pill work if it's in your head?'), a real-looking person answers it for 3-4 minutes. The reply frame makes the length feel earned.

For the cheating story: The whole v6 story as the answer. Open on the comment, then line 1 (hotel lot).

Ours: assets/video/ed/staging/black-cactus-comment-reply-variations-frameio-2026-10-05/ (10 cuts). Winner: Biker + Maya, winners.md #27.

Motion: letter 10.8% hit · it is a STATIC

2. Letter (text-only static, signed)

Correction from the first version of this board: Motion's "Letter" is a written message in big blocks of text, minimal imagery, personal tone, usually signed. A static you READ, not a video you hear. Real examples below.

For the cheating story: "Dear guy who was told it's all in your head," five short paragraphs, signed by a first name. Cheapest test on the page, and it carries the keep-vs-start line in writing.

Examples: Huel "Dear Huel Skeptic" (signed Julian), Lume apology letter, Manscaped "Bittersweet goodbye," Honeylove, Jones Road, Our Place, Purple, Prose, Happy Mammoth, Comfrt.

Notes
To my ex-wife

I'm in a hotel parking lot, watching you laugh at another man.

It started three years earlier with two words.

"Long week."

I said it the first time, you kissed my head…

DAVID'S PICK · RYZE runs the container

2b. Narrated story, "audiobook with pictures"

A man's voice tells the story start to finish. The screen shows it: storyboard stills, light animation, b-roll, a line of text now and then. No talking head. Can open on the Notes-app letter for 3 seconds, then cut to pictures. Same container as RYZE's "pool dad Mike" and "woman in her 30s" story ads, and the day-by-day timeline ads in the ED section.

For the cheating story: the v6 lines as spoken narration, one picture per line, the Notes cold open on line 1. Second port after comment reply.

David 10/19: "like an audiobook, but instead of picturing it in your head you see it on screen." Example: tap the RYZE links on card 3.

S tier on X Q4 2026

3. AI drama / Pixar skit, spoken (no singing)

Animated characters act the story out with dialogue, plot twist, product at the end. RYZE's 'new obsession' per X, scaled at 1M+ impressions in 30 days.

For the cheating story: Same scenes as the song, spoken. Only after the song has a read, own ad set.

The supplement shops that make really good ads (10/19, David's call)

Three networks, persona pages, one advertorial per condition slice, 8-20 cuts each. Same promise as us. Full hook grammar and our translations: research/directmax/supplement-ed-swipe-2026-10-19.md. Tap ▶ to watch.

138 DUPES · biggest ad in the pull

"Here's what to do to fix all three" (Aurivita)

"Your prostate is the reason you can't get hard, your T is tanked, and you piss 12 times a night. Here's what to do to fix all three." Organ first, one mechanism line, four ingredients, then all-in-one.

Our version: "Can't start it. Can't keep it. Can't stop thinking about it. Here's the one thing that fixes all three." Narrated, faceless.

5 DUPES · fear ladder

"Diabetic ED has five stages" (Noverly)

"By stage five, you're putting needles in before every encounter. Stage one, sugar damages the thinnest nerve in your body…" Each stage worse, you place yourself on the ladder.

Our version: "Performance anxiety has four stages. Stage one: one bad night, you say 'long week.' Stage four: she's stopped asking." Then the fix at stage one.
